The Altar of nightmares is a workshop available to the [[Succubus]] race.

{| class="wikitable"
! Reaction !! Key !! Materials !! Result
|-
| Visit a broker's nightmares || {{k|b}}
| 1 [[craft]]
|
*Adds 15 points to [[Appraisal]]
*Adds 15 points to one of [[Lying]], [[Flattery]] or [[Record keeping]] (randomly)
|-
| Visit a crafter's nighmares || {{k|c}}
| 1 [[craft]]
|
*Adds 15 points to one of [[Woodcrafting]], [[Stonecrafting]], [[Metalcrafting]], [[Glasscrafting]] or [[Leathercrafting]] (randomly)
|-
| Visit a farmer's nighmares || {{k|f}}
| 1 [[food]]
|
*Adds 15 points to one of [[Planting]], [[Cooking]] or [[Brewing]] (randomly)
|-
| Visit a warrior's nighmares || {{k|w}}
| 1 [[ammo]]
|
*Adds 15 points to one of [[Siege operator]], [[Dodging]], [[Armor user]], [[Fighting]] or [[Archery]] (randomly)
|-
| Provoke a siege || {{k|s}}
|
*1 [[oboe]]
*1 two-handed sword(?)
|
*Causes a siege to occur (random non-slaver race -- see below)
|-

| 3 [[soul]]s
|
*Causes a [[Gnome]] merchant caravan to arrive
|-

|

|-

|

|-
| Lure dwarven merchants to their doom || {{k|f}}
| 3 [[soul]]s
|
